title: Global Account Executive at United Media
description: <p>Are you someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, where you are given the autonomy and support to handle large amounts of responsibility?</p> <p>Are you looking for the opportunity to accelerate your sales career whilst also being surrounded by an exceptional entrepreneurial team with motivated and extremely driven people?</p> <h3>About us</h3> <p>United Media focuses on building large-scale industry media and conference products across sectors such as private equity, insurance, HR, retail and finance. As of today, we have organically launched 8 media companies and acquired one, including Private Equity Insights, Insurtech Insights, Presidents Summit, HRtechX, CFO Insights, Retail Insights and SetSales.</p> <p>We bring together thousands of executives, investors, founders and industry leaders at our conferences around the world, creating opportunities for people to learn, connect and build meaningful business relationships.</p> <h3>What we offer you</h3> <p>You will be a key player in helping to build the greatest global conferences. We will ensure that you are given both the training and tools to succeed in the role and drive you to continue to push yourself in order to maximise your career development. You’ll be based out of our HQ in London where you will have the opportunity to interact with people at all levels across the business. We will offer you the following:</p> <ul> <li> <p>A competitive salary and market leading OTE.</p> </li> <li> <p>An opportunity for getting operational experience in a scale-up business where both your work and the results are highly tangible and matters to the businesses.</p> </li> <li> <p>A chance to work closely with our senior leadership team on conference strategies.</p> </li> <li> <p>International travel to our conferences.</p> </li> <li> <p>Unlimited growth potential in our group - we strongly believe in and have a track record of promoting internally.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Your Responsibilities</h3> <p>Your mission is to own the full sales cycle in selling high-value conference sponsorships to senior prospects. In order to be successful, your main duties will include:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Build new business revenue:</strong> Deliver credible, professional sales pitches to new prospects in order to achieve ambitious sales targets.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Pipeline development:</strong> Work with our marketing and analyst team to source, contact and set up meetings with potential sponsors.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Establish client relationships:</strong> Work closely with our content and delivery teams to ensure best-in-class delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Leverage our expertise:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with our content team to create compelling pitches to inspire our prospects.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>What we expect from you</h3> <p>You possess a strong work ethic with a high sense of urgency, and you have both the drive and desire to be the very best at what you do. You take ownership of everything you do, along with having a growth mindset constantly looking for areas to improve. Moreover, you share our passion for building and executing new businesses. We expect that you can demonstrate:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Sales excellence:</strong> At least 2 years of B2B sales experience and evidence of regularly outperforming targets.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Drive & Passion:</strong> Evidence of a passion for sales and business development.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Team Spirit:</strong> Are curious about people and love to speak, build and nurture relations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Communication Maestro:</strong> Showcase stellar verbal and written communication skills.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Pride in Work:</strong> Uphold the highest standards, ensuring every task you undertake is a testament to quality.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Start date:</strong> As soon as possible.</p> <p>Monday–Friday, we work from our <strong>WeWork office in Victoria, London</strong>. Due to the collaborative nature of our work, we do not offer remote work.</p> <p>You must have the right to work in the UK.</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Sector Lead (TMT) Directed Content
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About AlphaSense: </strong></h2> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content. </span></p> <p style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!</span></p></div><p><strong>About Expert Insights:</strong><br>Expert Insights, which spans AlphaSense’s Expert Transcript Library and 1x1 Call Services offerings,<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>delivers a new and transformative form of market intelligence content. Through transcripts covering thousands of companies, it captures the unfiltered views and insights of business operators in the trenches, interviewed by professional investors who drill into key questions on what’s truly important about a company at each moment in time. AlphaSense’s library of over 220,000 transcripts is the market’s largest, covering all sectors of the economy, with thousands more published each month. Expert Insights is quickly becoming a table-stakes solution for institutional investors to choose the right companies to invest in while gaining rapid adoption among all other consumers of market intelligence from sell-side research and banking, consultancies, and large corporations.</p> <p><strong>About the Team:</strong></p> <p>The Directed Content Team is an integral part of the Expert Insights group, generating thousands of calls each quarter on high-value and strategic content targets - ensuring that the AlphaSense Expert Transcript Library (ETL) delivers comprehensive coverage to our users. The Directed Content team is responsible for identifying, recruiting, and onboarding the best possible experts from around the world based on the targets and topics we are looking to generate content against - ensuring that the interviews with those experts are of the highest-possible quality and relevance.</p> <p><strong>About the Role:<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></strong></p> <p>As a Sector Lead on our TMT (Technology, Media and Telecoms) Directed Content team, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring AlphaSense delivers the highest-quality proprietary research content within your assigned sector. Reporting to the Director of Research (TMT) you will oversee the day-to-day execution of Directed Content projects, ensuring all work meets the firm’s standards for quality, relevance, and, end-user value delivery. As Sector Lead, you will manage coverage of EMEA and APAC companies.</p> <p>You will combine operational rigor with sector expertise to oversee a team of Project Managers responsible for generating expert call transcripts across a diverse range of topics within your coverage universe. Your responsibilities will span project setup, expert sourcing guidance, transcript quality assurance, budget oversight, and performance management. Acting as the connective layer between the Director of Research’s strategic vision and day-to-day execution, you will ensure flawless delivery of sector coverage plans while maintaining a pulse on emerging market themes and client information needs.</p> <p>You will also serve as a key stakeholder in developing and optimizing project workflows, implementing structured QA and feedback loops, and partnering with Product and Operations teams to pilot new AI-enabled tools that elevate both efficiency and insight quality.</p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong><span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span></p> <ul> <li>Partner with<span class="Apple-converted-space">  </span>the Director of Research to develop and maintain a strategic sector roadmap, which you will then translate into a structured execution plan, ensuring coverage aligns with key market and client priorities.</li> <li>Manage and mentor a team of Project Managers that oversee the execution of Directed Content projects, setting clear goals, tracking KPIs, and ensuring accountability across all deliverables.</li> <li>Collaborate with Operations Managers who oversee Analyst execution of expert recruiting, onboarding, and interaction facilitation to align operational KPIs to coverage strategy and optimize execution</li> <li>Own expert budget management for your sector, allocating resources effectively to maximize content ROI while maintaining high quality and throughput.</li> <li>Oversee a structured QA process for ensuring transcripts within your sector of coverage meet the highest standards for data accuracy, relevance, structure, and analytical depth.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research and our Content Strategy Analyst to monitor engagement data, identify coverage gaps, and recalibrate project pipelines accordingly.</li> <li>Collaborate closely with the Director of Research to identify and shape content to support revenue-generating efforts such as white papers, webinars, internal and external presentations.</li> <li>Establish and maintain feedback loops with call takers and project teams to enhance the quality and insight of future content.</li> <li>Collaborate with North America directed content teams to ensure high quality output and consistency.</li> <li>Partner with Operations and Product teams to pilot and optimize AI-enabled tools that improve project throughput, QA precision, and overall efficiency.</li> <li>Maintain deep familiarity with ongoing developments within the Healthcare, TMT or Energy & Industrial sectors, proactively surfacing new themes and companies to guide future research focus.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Who You Are:</strong></p> <ul> <li>You have 5–7 years of experience in equity research, market intelligence, consulting, or a related analytical role within TMT</li> <li>You bring deep domain expertise in Technology, Media & Telecoms with a strong grasp of the key players, business models, and industry trends shaping your space.</li> <li>You have a strong understanding of European and Asian equity markets.</li> <li>You have proven people management experience, successfully leading, mentoring, and developing teams of project managers or analysts.</li> <li>You are skilled at translating strategic objectives into actionable research projects that yield high-impact insights.</li> <li>You possess exceptional organizational, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, able to balance multiple priorities with agility while maintaining high quality standards.</li> <li>You have a strong command of project economics, capable of managing budgets, optimizing expert costs, and tracking ROI to ensure resource efficiency.</li> <li>You are adept at working cross-functionally with Directors of Research, Go-to-Market, Product, and Compliance to ensure alignment and continuous improvement.</li> <li>You are intellectually curious, client-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.</li> <li>You maintain a strong understanding of compliance, MNPI, and confidentiality standards across all project types.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Recruiting Scams and Fraud</span></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">All official communications will come from an @<a href="http://alpha-sense.com/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=http://alpha-sense.com/&source=gmail&ust=1740162734907000&usg=AOvVaw2sfhQUZloRzVpQ4Yj1Ftlo">alpha-sense.com</a> email address.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our <a href="https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.alpha-sense.com/careers/&source=gmail&ust=1740162734907000&usg=AOvVaw3I0CFwb1ser7ImCRD48YOl">Careers page</a>.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.</span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Software Engineer, Alts Data Management
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span></h4> <p>We are currently seeking a staff software engineer to join the Alternatives Data Management (ADM) team. Our team is building AI-powered data products and workflow solutions that unlock transparency, efficiency, and insight in private market investments. You’ll join a talented full-stack team of engineers and work on distributed services that are used across the entire ADM engineering stack.</p> <p>Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.</p> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end delivery of complex, multi-month initiatives within ADM, including work that spans team boundaries. Anticipate risks and unblock dependencies before they become delivery blockers.</li> <li>Lead technical designs for new products and workflow solutions, aligned with ADM and Addepar’s longer-term strategy. Solicit feedback and build consensus.</li> <li>Write exemplary, highly performant, and scalable code and frameworks.</li> <li>Evangelize and promote best engineering practices.</li> <li>Serve as a primary technical point of contact. Initiate and lead collaboration with cross-functional teams to resolve complex application and infrastructure issues.</li> <li>Mentor engineers, identify skill gaps and help shape their technical development.</li> <li>Communicate technical strategy, trade-offs, and architectural direction clearly to both engineering and non-engineering stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h4><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who You Are</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience</li> <li>Extensive software engineering experience</li> <li>Track record of leading technical initiatives from design through delivery</li> <li>Comfortable working independently, with a bias for action</li> <li>Strong ownership mentality and drive to solve the most important problems</li> <li>Excel at written and verbal communication</li> <li>Experience with financial services or wealth management operations</li> <li>Experience with object-oriented programming</li> <li>Experience with AWS or another cloud platform</li> <li>Experience with IaC (infrastructure as code), preferably Terraform</li> <li>Experience with gen AI for coding</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Our Values </strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Act Like an Owner - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Our clients’ success is our success. </span></li> <li><strong>Drive Innovation - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry. </span></li> <li><strong>Embrace Learning - </strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Look beyond individual markets to measure the impact of wider changes across our portfolio and turn your findings into clear strategic recommendations. Help shape how SEO evolves at Legend, reducing repetitive manual work and creating more space for strategic thinking, experimentation and high-impact optimisation. title: Demo Engineer
description: About Zip Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. Your Role You'll be a force multiplier for the Pre-sales organization. You'll own how Zip demos end to end: the environments, data, scripts, and certification standards that let any Solution Engineer deliver a technically credible demo quickly and consistently. You will be responsible for developing the solution demo frameworks, reusable assets, and self-service approach that every Solution Engineer and Account Executive benefits from. You’ll work closely with Solution Engineering leadership, Enterprise Architecture, Product, and Product Marketing to design our demos of the future. This is a hands-on builder role, not a maintenance seat. You're building the systems and vision for what a great demo looks like at Zip. What You'll Do Own demo environment build and operations: Design, build, and maintain the demo environments, data sets, demo pathways, and demo scripts every SEs uses. Build self-service tooling and templates: Turn demo-builds into packages assets that SEs and AEs can pull directly. Shape our demo narratives and storytelling: Develop the talk tracks, narrative arcs, and messaging that turn technical features into a story every SE can tell. Keep demo assets in lockstep with releases: Partner with Product and Product Marketing so new agents, integrations, and vertical use cases ship with a working demo environment and script. Automate scripting and asset generation with AI: Use LLMs and AI coding tools to generate and maintain demo scripts, synthetic data, and environment scaffolding, cutting manual build time on every new demo asset. Automate end-to-end demo workflows with Playwright: Script and maintain Playwright-based flows that walk through full demo scenarios automatically, so environments get validated and refreshed without manual QA. Build with AI-native development tools: Prototype and ship internal tooling using tools like Replit and Lovable, taking new demo assets from idea to working build. Build and maintain agentic loops: Design agent workflows that can prepare, validate, and repair demo environments on their own, catching broken flows before an SE does. Qualifications 2–5+ years in technical pre-sales, sales engineering, or demo engineering at a high-growth B2B SaaS company. Real hands-on build skills: scripting fluency (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar), comfort with REST APIs and webhooks, and enough cloud/infrastructure familiarity (AWS, GCP, or Azure) to stand up and operate a demo environment without waiting on engineering. Hands-on experience using AI to automate scripting and asset generation Experience automating end-to-end workflows with Playwright or a comparable browser-automation framework, for demo environment validation, regression testing, or scripted walkthroughs. Direct experience building with AI-native development tools such as Replit, Lovable, or similar. Comfortable going from a blank canvas to a working prototype largely through AI-assisted building. Experience designing and maintaining agentic loops: multi-step AI agent workflows that execute, evaluate, and self-correct. A systems thinker who can tell the difference between fixing the one-off request in front of them and building the thing that prevents the next ten. Strong storytelling instincts: you know the difference between a feature tour and a demo that lands, and you can teach that difference to other people. A strong cross-functional operator: you'll work daily with SE leadership, Product, PMM, and Enterprise Architecture, and you know how to get alignment without a committee. Nice to have Experience selling into procurement, finance, or supply chain functions. Familiarity with ERP and enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, ServiceNow) and how they intersect with procurement technology, for cross-system demo integrations. Perks & Benefits At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. 📈 Start-up equity 🦷 Health, vision & dental coverage Commuter benefit 🌴 Flexible PTO 💻 Apple equipment plus home office stipend 5% Employer Pension Contribution We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you! Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager
description: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’. The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years. Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. About the role We’re looking for a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager to join our Customer Experience team at Pleo. In this role, you’ll own a portfolio of large, complex, and strategically important enterprise customers, helping them achieve measurable business outcomes, expand adoption, manage change, and build long-term value with Pleo. You’ll serve as a trusted advisor to senior customer stakeholders while coordinating the broader Pleo relationship across Customer Success, Product, Support, Sales, Finance, and other internal teams. This is not a reactive account-management role. You’ll be expected to understand each customer’s business priorities, operating model, success criteria, and risk profile. You’ll turn that understanding into clear success plans, executive engagement strategies, adoption programs, renewal plans, and growth opportunities. The right candidate will bring at least three years of direct experience managing enterprise customers , along with the communication skills, commercial judgment, and operational discipline required to manage high-value relationships in a fast-paced technology environment. Who you’ll be working with and reporting to You’ll report to our Manager of Customer Success, Large & High-Growth Customers and work closely with teams across: Customer Support Customer Onboarding Sales and Account Management Product and Product Operations Revenue Operations Finance Data and Analytics Program Management and Operations You’ll work with customer stakeholders across finance, procurement, operations, technology, transformation, and executive leadership. You’ll be responsible for creating alignment across these stakeholders, establishing clear governance, and ensuring Pleo remains connected to the customer’s evolving strategic and operational priorities. What you’ll be doing As a Senior Enterprise Customer Success Manager , you will: Own a portfolio of enterprise customers with accountability for customer health, value realisation, adoption, retention, renewal readiness, advocacy, and growth. Build trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders , positioning yourself as a credible advisor who understands their business priorities and operating environment. Maintain detailed and accurate forecasts across renewals, risk, customer health, expected outcomes, growth opportunities, and major account milestones. Lead renewal-readiness activities by ensuring customer value is documented, risks are addressed, stakeholders are aligned, and commercial partners have accurate account intelligence. Identify and support expansion opportunities by connecting additional Pleo capabilities, products, or use cases to the customer’s evolving business needs. Coordinate complex customer escalations across Support, Product, Engineering, Finance, and other teams while maintaining clear and confident customer communication. Act as the customer’s internal advocate , ensuring customer needs, feedback, risks, and opportunities are visible to the right stakeholders at Pleo. Navigate customer change effectively , including leadership transitions, reorganisations, acquisitions, market expansion, platform changes, and evolving business priorities. Track customer commitments and outcomes with strong operational discipline, ensuring actions are documented, owned, and completed. Contribute to the evolution of Pleo’s enterprise Customer Success model by sharing best practices, customer insights, playbooks, and recommendations. Support peer development and knowledge sharing across the Customer Success team without holding direct people-management responsibility. To put things into context In this role, you can expect to work on priorities such as: strengthening relationships with Pleo’s largest and most strategic customers improving enterprise customer retention and renewal predictability increasing adoption across complex customer organisations creating stronger executive engagement and governance identifying churn risk before it becomes a renewal issue improving forecast accuracy and account visibility coordinating complex customer needs across multiple internal teams helping customers quantify and communicate the value they receive from Pleo identifying opportunities for expansion and deeper product adoption improving the consistency and quality of enterprise success planning helping customers navigate operational and organisational change turning customer feedback into actionable Product and CX insight You can expect to work across a technology environment that includes CRM, Customer Success platforms, support systems, product analytics, business intelligence tools, workflow tools, and collaboration platforms . Examples may include Vitally, Gainsight or similar, Zendesk, Looker, Tableau or Power BI, Jira, Asana, and Slack. What you bring You’ll thrive in this role if you have: At least three years of direct enterprise Customer Success or strategic account-management experience , managing large, complex, and high-value B2B customers. Five or more years of overall experience in Customer Success, account management, consulting, implementation, or a related customer-facing role. Experience working in SaaS, fintech, enterprise technology, or another complex B2B technology environment . A proven record of retaining and growing enterprise customers , including managing renewals, adoption, risk, and value realisation. Strong executive relationship-management skills , with the confidence and credibility to engage senior decision-makers and business leaders. Experience managing complex stakeholder environments involving multiple teams, business units, regions, entities, or decision-makers. Strong churn-prediction and prevention skills , including the ability to interpret customer signals, identify root causes, and build effective recovery plans. Detailed forecasting experience across renewals, customer risk, account health, adoption, and expansion opportunities. Strong commercial judgment , with an understanding of how customer outcomes connect to retention, revenue, expansion, and long-term account value. Excellent verbal and written communication skills , including the ability to lead difficult conversations, present to executives, and simplify complex issues. Experience building strategic success plans, account plans, stakeholder maps, and executive business reviews . Strong analytical skills , with the ability to interpret customer data, product usage, service trends, and business information. Strong cross-functional leadership skills , with the ability to align internal stakeholders without relying on direct authority. A structured and proactive approach to account management , with excellent follow-through and attention to detail. Comfort working in a fast-paced growth environment where customer expectations, internal priorities, and business needs can evolve quickly. The ability to balance strategic relationship management with detailed operational execution . Nice to have Experience in fintech, payments, spend management, financial operations, or expense-management technology Experience working with finance leaders, procurement teams, controllers, CFO organisations, or transformation leaders Experience managing multi-country or multinational enterprise customers Familiarity with ERP, accounting, procurement, or financial-system integrations Experience supporting customers through significant organisational or technology transformation Exposure to AI-enabled Customer Success, predictive health models, automated risk detection, or digital engagement Experience partnering with Product teams on strategic customer feedback and roadmap discussions Experience managing accounts with complex security, compliance, governance, or implementation requirements Why is this role a good fit for you? This role is a good fit for you if: You enjoy building strategic relationships with complex enterprise customers. You are comfortable engaging senior leaders and navigating high-stakes customer situations. You know how to connect product adoption to measurable customer outcomes. You are proactive about identifying and addressing churn risk. You combine strong relationship skills with rigorous account-management discipline. You are confident leading executive reviews, renewal discussions, and difficult customer conversations. You enjoy coordinating internal teams around complex customer needs. You want direct responsibility for protecting and growing some of Pleo’s most important customer relationships. You prefer working independently without significant cross-functional coordination. You are looking for a people-management role rather than a senior individual-contributor position. description: <p>We are hiring for the <strong>Head of Financial Planning & Analysis</strong>, to lead the global FP&A Teams and be a leader within the wider finance team. You will play a key part leading our monthly business reviews and forecasting, annual planning, and continuously drive cross-functional business alignment, as well as develop the long term roadmap for the FP&A team. Our ideal candidate is a highly analytical independent thinker, who has a proven record of leading a team to use data analysis to advise on critical financial, commercial and strategic decisions.</p> <p>Our business opportunity is significant; we can deliver both infrastructure and business applications to the enterprise market. As companies refresh their data centers, our goal is to be the platform for cloud and apps. As they re-architect their business applications to embrace open source, our goal is to deliver the majority of their databases, analytics, messaging, publishing, identity, security, workflow... everything that is open source. We are committed to do that at the most efficient price points possible to drive down the total cost of IT, but this is nevertheless a significant global market, and our ambition is to be counted among the most valued software suppliers to the Global 10,000.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This is a remote role in AMER or EMEA time zones, with the option to be based in our London office.</p> <h3>The role entails</h3> <ul> <li>Develop executive reporting dashboards and documents including Board reporting, monthly financial results and other management presentations</li> <li>Analyse & Report monthly results, leading indicators and KPIs to support monthly forecasting and annual plan attainment</li> <li>Provide commercial analysis, develop growth targets, and evaluate strategic initiatives</li> <li>Work with product managers to produce, aggregate, and distribute both market insights and competitive intelligence</li> <li>Manage financial models, including budgeting, forecasting, and long range planning</li> <li>Drive improvements in data analysis, and determine the appropriate processes, methodologies, and modeling techniques to deliver insights.</li> <li>Partner with Accounting and Investor Relations to support month end close, flux review processes, and financial reporting</li> <li>Drive multi-functional change projects designed to enhance systems, processes, and data accuracy</li> <li>Play a key role in preparation of critical public financial documents to support an IPO process, including supporting the production of investor materials and public filings</li> <li>Guide the annual FP&A activity calendar to provide decision support to the executive team</li> <li>Mentor colleagues within the FP&A team, as well as peer teams</li> <li>Control costs via methodical reviews of department spend, procurement strategies, and business wide process efficiency</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What we are looking for in you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>An exceptional academic track record</li> <li>Experience and a deeply rooted passion to lead successful team members, and aid in their career growth </li> <li>Have operated in a high growth, multi currency/geography technology business with a mixed go-to-market motion</li> <li>Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities</li> <li>Highest ethical standards, integrity, authenticity, credibility, and character</li> <li>Curiosity and willingness to work on a wide range of projects</li> <li>Proficiency in spreadsheets, financial modeling, and BI tools</li> <li>Understanding of core accounting principles </li> <li>Professional written and spoken English </li> <li>Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability </li> <li>Passionate, thoughtful, and self-motivated</li> <li>Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet and exceed commitments </li> <li>International travel 2-4 times a year for company events up to two weeks long</li> </ul> <h3>Nice-to-have skills</h3> <ul> <li>MBA or equivalent combination of professional certifications and experience</li> <li>Previous experience as a subject matter expert in Financial Planning & Analysis</li> <li>Experience with Business Intelligence reporting, CRM and ERP systems</li> </ul> <h3>What we offer colleagues</h3> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review</li> <li>Company recognition rewards</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access</li> </ul> <h3>About Canonical</h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <h3>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</h3> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Software Engineering Manager, Billing & Integrations
description: At Sanity.io , we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like SKIMS , Figma , Riot Games , Anthropic , COMPLEX , Nordstrom , and Morningbrew are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations. We’re looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Billing & Integrations, the team behind usage metering, plans and subscriptions, spend controls, invoices, and selected partner integrations. Your team makes it possible for us to launch billable capabilities and to run routine billing through reliable APIs and tools. You’ll also keep our integrations dependable and current. Leading a team at Sanity means owning strategy, roadmap, and execution alongside your product partner. This is a player-coach role: most of your time will go to people, priorities, and delivery, while you stay close enough to the code to review designs, unblock difficult problems, and guide technical decisions. What you will do: Lead delivery of a reliable monetization platform Own the engineering roadmap with Product, balancing new billing capabilities, customer-facing improvements, reliability, and reducing manual work. Guide the usage-to-invoice architecture: metering correctness, subscription lifecycle, reconciliation, and dependable budget and limit enforcement. Turn recurring plan, coupon, credit, and invoicing requests into documented APIs and self-service tools that other teams can operate independently. Coach and develop the engineering team Develop engineers through clear feedback, meaningful ownership, career support, and hiring as the team’s needs evolve. Stay technically engaged through architecture reviews, pairing, and code where it helps the team most; strengthen testing, observability, incident response, and safe migration practices. Partner across Sanity Work with Product, Growth, Finance, RevOps, Support, and engineering teams to make pricing and billing requirements clear, surface trade-offs early, and protect customer trust. Keep existing partner integrations reliable and aligned with upstream API changes. Measure impact through billing accuracy, self-service adoption, commercial lead time, and operational health. About you: Based in Oslo, Norway, or London, UK. You communicate technical designs and trade-offs clearly, in writing and in conversation, with both engineers and non-technical partners. You have proven experience managing engineers and delivering software at a product or SaaS company, backed by a substantial hands-on engineering background. You’ve led backend or platform systems where correctness and reliability matter. Experience in billing, payments, usage metering, subscriptions, or entitlements is especially useful. You turn ambiguity into clear priorities, deliver incrementally, and can show how your team’s work improved customer or business outcomes. You care about growing people and building a team with shared ownership. You work effectively across functions and timezones, and replace recurring manual work with reusable capabilities. You can reason deeply about event-driven systems, API contracts, idempotency, retries, consistency, reconciliation, and safe changes to critical state. Familiarity with Orb, Stripe, or Temporal is a plus; transferable engineering judgment matters more than a particular vendor. Not sure you’re exactly what we’re looking for in this role? Apply anyway! title: Sales Engineer
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? About the role We are looking for a sales engineer to join our sales team and drive the frontline of industrial decarbonisation. This role bridges the technical and commercial worlds. You'll need interpersonal and technical skills to build relationships with process engineers in cement plants and understand their challenges. Analytical skills will be essential to delve deep into complex plant data and work out how Gigaton's AI products can solve their most critical issues. Building on that, you'll need strategic thinking and commercial awareness to turn your findings into concise, compelling proposals for decision-makers at our customers, from the C-suite down. Ultimately, you'll build clarity from uncertainty, making sure we agree a shared roadmap with our customers that puts our solutions on track for significant real-world benefits before a contract is signed. Over time, you’ll help us evolve our sales approach and shape the product by feeding insights and needs from the plant back to the product team, building the foundation for scaling across industries. Your main responsibilities Be the technical expert on sales calls and visits with cement plants. Build trust with process engineers and plant teams by understanding their specific plant issues and linking them to how we can help. Analyse plant data to identify and evaluate opportunities, then use this analysis to create compelling sales proposals. Lead technical discovery and identify early when a plant does not meet our ICP (ideal customer profile) criteria. Make sure relationships and plant understanding are handed over successfully to the deployment team. Act as a feedback loop into Gigaton’s product and machine learning teams, providing field insights that help shape our product roadmap. Develop and iterate the pre-sales technical process, making it more impactful and more automated each time. Travel to plants and conferences , around one week per month, to understand customer environments and explain the product. What a great fit looks like Exposure to physical sciences, controls, or heavy industry , such as cement, steel, energy, manufacturing, or similar. Strong analytical skills and an outcome-oriented mindset. You can dig into industrial data, identify root causes, generate potential solutions, and explain their value in dollars and tonnes of CO2. Excellent communication skills . You can build credibility and trust in complex industrial environments with both engineers and board-level stakeholders. Comfortable being the technical voice in the conversation , presenting to senior plant leaders and operators, handling objections, and being challenged on your findings by people who have run kilns for 30 years. Naturally curious and keen to learn about the industry, the technology, and each individual plant. You want to understand the root cause behind every question and objection so you can solve the right problem. Confident in ambiguity and able to field very specific technical questions without getting flustered. You know when you can give your understanding, when you need to go and find the answer, and how to maintain customer confidence in both situations. Willingness to travel regularly . You’ll excel if You build trust easily . You can connect with plant engineers, listen deeply, and align solutions to their priorities. You’d rather diagnose than pitch . Your first instinct in a plant is to ask a better question, not to open the deck. You thrive in dynamic environments . Fast-paced, ambiguous settings excite you, and you’re motivated by high-impact, mission-driven work. You have experience working in heavy industry , particularly cement, steel, energy, heavy manufacturing, or similar. Success in This Role Means Plants say yes because the technical case is clear. You build customer confidence that Gigaton can deliver high ROI, helping us hit our revenue goals without losing deals because customers don’t understand or believe in our product and capabilities. Deployments are set up to succeed . We haven’t overpromised to sign a contract, and our pre-contract analysis holds up once the system is live. Process engineers trust and rely on you as a partner in solving problems. Deals don’t stall waiting on a technical answer . Objections get handled quickly, and customers get the answers they need in good time. 💡 You are not expected to check every box, and we’d love to hear from you even if your experience isn’t an exact match. We’re building a team that reflects the world we want to change. Our people come from all walks of life, with different countries, cultures, and experiences, and we think that’s one of our biggest strengths. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels safe, respected, and celebrated. No matter your background, if you’re excited by what we do, we want to hear from you. The interview process Talent Partner Screen Call: Meet our talent partner and learn more about Gigaton and the role. Hiring Manager Screen: Meet our VP of Sales and discuss if this role is a good fit for you. Technical Onsite (completed on the same day): Technical interview Data analysis & presentation Operating Principles Interview: Understand how we work and whether Gigaton and you are a good fit for each other. Meet with the CEO: Every new potential hire meets Josh. We believe hiring is a two-way process. Just as we’ll reference-check candidates before making a final offer, we encourage you to reference-check us by chatting to team members you haven’t yet met. Ask anything. We’ll answer with Concrete Honesty. Once interviews are done, we’ll move quickly to a decision, and we’re always happy to give feedback at any stage. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. title: Commercial Customer Success Manager
description: A little about us incident.io is the AI software reliability platform trusted by engineering teams at Netflix, Etsy, and 2,000+ companies who can't afford downtime. The stakes are real, the talent is insane, and somehow it's a genuinely lovely place to work. We all pull our weight, go the extra mile, and put in the bit of magic most companies don't have time for, all while having fun and never taking ourselves too seriously. We've raised $96 million from Index Ventures, Insight Partners, and Point Nine, and we're growing fast. There's never been a better time to join. The role in one line Customers trust us when things go wrong. We're the software reliability platform built to investigate, respond to and prevent incidents. As a Commercial CSM, you're the partner to our mid-market engineering teams - getting them onboarded, embedded and expanding their usage, and maturing their incident management and reliability as they grow. What that looks like day to day Our Customer Success organisation is at the heart of incident.io . We're the team closest to our customers' hardest problems, and we're trusted to solve them. We believe in a customer-led product approach, working hand in hand with Product to uncover and address what each customer really needs. Our goal goes beyond satisfaction: we want to delight customers at every stage of their journey, and build long-term relationships grounded in trust, shared success and mutual growth. You'll look after 70–80 Commercial customers: growth-oriented tech companies, mostly under 1,000 people, between $30k and $150k ARR each. Industry leaders like Vanta, Monday.com and Loom sit in this segment. Some are steady, some are scaling fast, and much of the job is knowing which is which, and what each one needs from you. Most of your time goes to mid-market customers on our top-tier plan, where you're their dedicated CSM leading onboarding and adoption. You'll blend 1:1 time with scalable programmes to get teams to value quickly: best-practice sessions, end-user training, partnership and roadmap reviews. You'll also cover a subset of smaller customers in a low-touch capacity, leaning on usage data to spot risk and opportunity early. Day to day, this is a high ownership role. You'll help customers navigate the product, unpick problems when they hit them, and keep everyone pointed at the outcomes their team actually cares about. You are responsible for proactively identifying expansion and upsell opportunities, and partnering with Sales and Expansion Account Managers to grow revenue within your accounts. Internally, you're the voice of the Commercial customer with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing and Support. There's still a lot to build and a ton of opportunity for you to shape this segment. The Commercial motion works, but scaling and automating the customer journey is live work we're ramping up now - refining playbooks, automating the repeatable stuff, building the tooling and content that makes a portfolio this size easier to serve. We're AI-forward in how we approach it, so you'd be shaping this rather than inheriting it. Who you are You've carried a book of 40 to 100+ accounts and worked out how to be present across all of them without going quiet on half. You've sold to, or supported, technical people, whether that's engineering teams, on-call rotations or developer tools. You can hold your own in a technical conversation without needing to escalate every one of them. You've got commercial instincts. You spot the account that's about to double, you know what a growth signal looks like, and you know how to steer a renewal to a good outcome. You know what scaled CS looks like when it's done well. Playbooks, one-to-many programs, AI-assisted workflows. You don't need to have built them from scratch, but you've worked around them enough to have opinions on what you'd do differently. Half-built process doesn't rattle you. You'd rather fix the documentation than complain about it. You actually like being in a room with customers, and you'll get on a plane for the right one. Supporting you We work hard and we think life outside work matters just as much. Our benefits pack is built to support both. Private medical insurance. Seriously good cover — we want you and the people you love to be looked after. Competitive annual leave. Showing up at your best requires switching off, and we make sure you have time to do that. First Friday of every month off. Yes, seriously. Enhanced pension. We put real money in, because future-you deserves better than an afterthought. Meaningful equity. We're rapidly scaling, and everyone who helps shape the outcome should share in it. Unlimited AI spend. For everyone, not just engineers. We're all-in on AI across the company, and we expect you to be too. Generous parental leave. The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them. Two budgets that have your back. £1000 to invest in your setup, £500 a year to invest in yourself. Explain AI governance, security posture, and resilience concepts credibly to both technical teams and executives. Guide clients through obligations such as the EU AI Act, NIS2, and ISO 42001, and help them stand up practical operating models: AI inventories, approval workflows, risk classification, and audit evidence.</p> <h3 data-section-id="1vy74ta" data-start="1643" data-end="1681">Scope and shape AI build projects.</h3> <p data-start="1682" data-end="2121">Sit with business stakeholders to understand the underlying need behind "we want AI for X." title: Senior Director, People & Culture
description: Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics. Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT BUILDING LEADERS, SHAPING CULTURE, AND ENABLING BUSINESS SUCCESS The Senior Director, People & Culture is a pivotal senior role within our London Office and a key member of Catapult's global P&C leadership team. Working three days in the office and partnering closely with senior business leaders, you will drive strategic impact while shaping both the culture and operational effectiveness of the EMEA region. Reporting to the Vice President, People & Culture, based in Melbourne, you will lead an in-region team of three and be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enable, engage, develop and retain exceptional talent. Success in this role requires a balance of strategic thinking and practical execution. WHAT YOU'LL DO Develop and execute strategic workforce plans, coaching senior leaders on organisational design, change management, communication, and talent development to drive engagement, retention, and business performance. Proven success partnering with senior leaders in a fast-paced, high-growth, global organisation to drive transformation and business outcomes. The ability to balance competing priorities across the employee lifecycle without compromising quality or attention to detail. Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing clarity, structure, and momentum to complex challenges. A strategic yet hands-on approach, balancing pace with employee development, engagement, and belonging. Experience designing creative, commercially driven solutions to complex business challenges. Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively at all levels of the organisation. High levels of energy, adaptability, and resilience, with the ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously. A passion for creating a market-leading employee experience and fostering a high-performance culture. Flexibility to work across global time zones when required. Leaders are empowered to navigate people challenges effectively, global P&C initiatives are successfully embedded across teams, and data and insights are being used to inform decisions. You are a valued member of the global P&C leadership team, helping shape and deliver a high-performance culture across Catapult. WHY CATAPULT? We have amazing people. We promise you'll work with some of the most ambitious, intelligent people in an exciting industry, and do some of the best work of your life. We encourage our people to engage in constructive, open, and honest communication to make Catapult extraordinary. You'll have the opportunity to work with people from multiple nationalities and cultures, and to build your global awareness. We value improvement and development. We are challenging ourselves to continuously grow and become a high-performance company. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do, and our people are always looking for ways to improve. There is an unlimited opportunity to grow, do more, and do better. Whether you're interested in sports or not, you'll have the satisfaction of knowing your work is supporting some of the most successful teams and athletes on the planet! We are building the future of sports performance. Our priority is to find the brightest talent who can add to our team culture, actively contribute, and be excited about what they do. If you look at most UX job ads, you see a laundry list of requirements. We prefer to tell you how we actually operate so you can decide if this is the right environment for you. At Street Group, design is a strategic seat. You'll drive direction alongside product and engineering, not respond to them. Our users rely on us to run their businesses, so they love talking to us. You can spin up a call and validate a prototype instantly. We don't guess; we ask. We move at pace, including on strategic work. Strategy isn't a separate, slower track here - we test it by shipping. Here's what you can expect to be working on Shape the UX of agentic AI across Street and Spectre - deciding which agency workflows agents should own, then designing how that actually feels and builds trust for the user. Design across the whole suite, not one domain - valuation, prospecting, marketing, enquiry handling, sales progression, property management. You'll hold a huge amount of context. Define the patterns for a new category. There's no established playbook for agentic UX in property - you'll set it. Set the craft bar through your own output. The work you ship is the reference point for what good looks like. Prototype, test and ship at pace - getting working prototypes in front of real agents and iterating fast. You should apply if: You've built or shaped agentic AI, not just used AI tools - multi-step, tool-using agents you've designed, prototyped or shipped. You understand how they work and where they break. You've got a well-formed point of view on agentic UX - how you design for systems that don't always behave the same way, how you build in trust, transparency and control, and when to keep a human in the loop. You stay current. This field moves monthly and you keep on top of it. You're energised by an undefined problem space and bring the case for what's worth doing, rather than waiting for a brief. You're commercially fluent - you make design trade-offs informed by how the product performs, not just user preference. You define success before you ship and read the result after. You probably shouldn't apply if: Your AI experience is limited to speeding up your own workflow. This role is about designing AI into the product, and that gap will show quickly. You're looking for the next pay band up from Senior with broadly similar expectations. This is not a "Senior+" role - it expects materially more scope, autonomy and judgment. You need a well-defined problem before you can start. Cortex is still taking shape, and that won't change soon. You expect to be handed a roadmap. Here, you help write it. A bit about you AI & agentic depth: Non-negotiable, and the first thing we'll screen for. Current, hands-on knowledge of agentic AI, with real examples of what you've built or shaped. Craft: Lead-level UX and product design. Your work is exemplary and you can articulate it clearly enough to teach. Breadth: Comfortable operating across the whole product suite and holding a lot of context at once, not going deep on a single domain. Ambiguity: You do your best work when the problem isn't yet defined. Cross-functional: A peer at the table with product and engineering, partnering closely with a good PM without treading on each other's toes. Technical fluency: Being hands-on enough to prototype with code is a real advantage here, given how close design sits to how these systems work. It's a plus, not a hard requirement. Experience: Typically this comes with around 8+ years in product/UX design at senior IC level - but we care more about evidence you can operate at Lead altitude than the exact number, especially given how new agentic AI is. SaaS or complex product experience is helpful; property experience isn't required. Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria, please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application. Why join Street Group? 🏠 Hybrid-working - you can work from home up to 4 days per week 🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!) 💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth 📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development 🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away 🙋 'Give something back' - 2 paid days volunteering on us 👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay 🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured 🧘 Regular well-being initiatives 🕒 Flexible working hours 🚂 Public transport season ticket loans 🌷 Paid menopause leave 🌞 Holiday buying scheme 🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition 👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! title: Operations Engineer
description: Odin is building the investment infrastructure for the future of private markets. We believe capital is one of the most powerful tools for shaping the world - and more people should know how to put it to work. Our mission is to make it radically easier to raise and deploy capital, so that anyone, anywhere, can back the companies and ideas they believe in. Our first product is a full-stack platform for launching and running private investment firms, allowing you to run everything from your phone - think Shopify for VC and PE. We handle all the infrastructure: from legal structuring and investor onboarding to KYC/AML, payments, tax, reporting, and exits. We're already trusted by over 10,000 angels, VCs, and founders. We administer over $750m in assets, covering investments from pre-seed to series E. This includes household names like ElevenLabs, OpenAI, SpaceX, xAI, Anduril, etc. but also new companies creating everything from synthetic brains to small nuclear reactors. Why we're hiring We are automating a decades old part of the financial services industry. AI pilled operators like you are the beating heart of this plan, because LLMs & agents allow us to turn this services business entirely into software. We're post-PMF, fast-growing, and rolling out new products (fund admin) & geographies (USA). Customer & deal volume is climbing fast. Today we're on track for roughly 700 deals a year, with a team of ~20, and we’ll process $500m-$750m of investment in 2026 alone. The next goal is 7,000 deals a year and billions in annual investment flows. We believe this can be achieved with a team of around 50 people. But it will only be possible if we turn human-driven services workflows into software. The operational machine behind Odin is still held together in many places by people and spreadsheets. Your job is to come in, understand every process and system, simplify, streamline and automate the shit out of it. You’ll be part of a small elite team embedded in operations and working closely with existing team members to build agents that automate work. We expect the right hire to be spending more time in Claude Code than in Excel, email or anything else. What you'll own Understand the work, then rebuild it: You’ll get close to how our operational teams actually work - the processes, edge cases, manual steps and things that slow them down. Your job is to understand them well enough to redesign, automate and build better ways of doing them. Build and automate: You’ll turn manual workflows into tools, automations and systems that make the business faster and more scalable. You’ll work autonomously and move quickly - often vibe coding something useful yourself before it ever needs traditional product or engineering resource. Bridge operations and engineering: You’ll know when something can be solved with process, automation or a lightweight build, and when it genuinely needs deeper engineering work. When it does, you’ll bring Product, Design and Engineering in with the problem already understood, simplified and proven. Delete things and say no: You’ll constantly question why a process exists, whether a request should be supported, and whether something is worth scaling. If a workflow exists for no good reason, you kill it. If a request creates complexity without enough value, we don’t do it. What we're looking for AI-pilled builder: Clear evidence, at work or in your own time, that you've built concrete solutions to problems with no budget and no engineers. No-code tooling, scripts, spreadsheets, vibe-coded apps and more. Numerate: Comfortable with financial mechanics, strong mental arithmetic. You’ll be working on automating a lot of numerical matters - carry, allocations, fee calculations, distributions, and the edge cases that make all of them interesting. In the details and extremely on top of things: You understand every single aspect of our systems end to end. You close loops, you chase, you push hard to get things done. First principles thinker: Although you're in the details and on top of execution, you also zoom out. You look at any process the way a good product manager looks at a product: What's the job? Why are we doing this at all? What's the smallest, simplest system that achieves the goal? A lot of what happens in fund admin is inherited convention, an industry "given", or a constraint of some third party. You should find it physically difficult to accept any of that. Big plus: regulated financial services background: Fund administration, custody, payments, brokerage, audit, tax or another back office function. Useful, but not required. SQL, serious Excel and other experience piping data between systems are all worth having too. However, we care much more about the traits you have and things you can build than specific skills or experience on your CV. If you're a few years into your career and you've already automated the shit out of your last job or built something incredible with AI, we want to talk to you. You want to operate, not manage: Odin is not a place for middle management. We all get shit done, regardless of title or seniority How we work There are five things we care about deeply: Reason from the ground up: Seek to understand what is true by always asking why. Do not trust convention or experts. Speed begets speed: We work fast. Speed compounds, it's the best form of defensibility, and it's energising to be around. If you work slowly, or tolerate slow work around you, you do not belong at Odin. Take ownership: Do not wait for permission to do things. Find the answer, force the thing into existence and hold others to an extremely high standard - the same standard you hold yourself to. Brutal honesty: If work doesn't meet the bar, people need to hear it, and the right people want to. Truly excellent customer service: Be a stickler for detail in every single interaction a customer has with us, and always strive to make this experience better, smoother, faster. This role is probably not for you if You'd rather build product than operate. Product instinct is required in this role, but a product management career is not what this is; You prefer close management of your responsibilities; You are risk-averse; You want a 9-5; You take yourself too seriously; You care about working for a company that’s raised lots of money rather than one that's extremely capital efficient and focused on building a profitable giant that has a positive economic impact Salary £70k - £90k base, plus a meaningful equity grant. We're flexible on the mix of cash and equity. Hiring process Three stages, usually inside two weeks, with detailed feedback within 24 hours of each one. Location & ways of working We're a London-based team. This role works closely with the founders, product and the wider ops team, and the speed we run at makes that much easier in-person. At least three days a week in the office. Benefits Health: Private health insurance (Vitality), paid sick leave including support for pregnancy loss and fertility treatments, and access to Spill for mental health support Wellness: £1,000 annual budget for health, therapy or fitness Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity, adoption, paternity and partner leave Pension: 4% employer contribution with salary sacrifice options Time Off: 25 days annual leave, 2 wellness days and flexible bank holidays (33 days total) Work From Anywhere: Up to 6 weeks per year working from anywhere globally Birthday Leave: An additional day of leave Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>3754 - Senior Associate, Search - Manchester</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Summary and Impact</strong></p> <p>As a Search Executive, you will manage the delivery and optimisation of paid search activity across your clients. You will build strong technical foundations, develop confidence across platforms, and understand how paid search contributes to broader client and business outcomes.</p> <p>Working closely with Senior Executives, Managers, and Directors, you will own defined areas of campaign execution, reporting, and analysis, developing the skills and confidence required to progress into more autonomous roles over time.</p> <p>As part of the WPP Media you’ll be encouraged to continuously learn, ask questions, and build craft excellence in a supportive team environment.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Campaign Support & Execution</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the setup, optimisation, and maintenance of paid search campaigns across platforms such as Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.</li> <li>Assist with keyword research, creative, bid adjustments, and budget pacing and optimisation under guidance from senior team members.</li> <li>Carry out quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure campaigns are accurate, compliant, and aligned to best practice.</li> <li>Help implement testing plans, learning how to measure impact and report results clearly.</li> <li>Support and quality check work delivered by Global Operations Centre (GOC) teams, escalating issues where required to maintain delivery standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting & Analysis</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the preparation of client performance reports and dashboards, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.</li> <li>Assist with performance analysis, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities to flag to clients and the wider team.</li> <li>Maintain internal trackers and documentation to support smooth delivery and transparency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Client & Team Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work collaboratively with Search and wider channel teams to support client deliverables.</li> <li>Attend internal and client meetings where appropriate, building confidence in how search performance is discussed.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Follow established processes and ways of working to minimise risk and ensure high standards of delivery.</li> <li>Support financial and operational hygiene by ensuring activity is accurately reflected in internal systems where required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Learning & Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Actively engage in training, certifications, and coaching to build paid search knowledge and capability.</li> <li>Seek feedback regularly and demonstrate progress against development goals.</li> <li>Contribute to team knowledge sharing by capturing learnings from tests, campaigns, or training.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>Skills and Experience</strong></p> <p>At WPP Media, we believe in the power of our culture and our people. In this role, it will be important to embrace WPP & WPP Media’s shared core values:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Be Extraordinary</strong> by leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity.</li> <li><strong>Create an Open environment</strong> by balancing people and client experiences through trust.</li> <li><strong>Lead Optimistically</strong> by championing growth and development.</li> </ul> <p>You will bring:</p> <ul> <li>A strong interest in paid search and digital marketing, with a desire to build a career in Search.</li> <li>Some hands-on experience or exposure to Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, or paid media platforms (through research, work, placements, or training).</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and a willingness to learn technical and analytical skills.</li> <li>High degree of confidence working with numbers and data, with curiosity about what performance trends mean.</li> <li>Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset.</li> <li>A proactive, organised approach to managing tasks and deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Life at WPP Media & Benefits</strong></p> <p>Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment.
